pcs.pc_description: • check and verify the weight and quality of the received raw materials through physical parameters from the supplier/warehouse • Raw materials: oil seeds such as peanut, sunflower seed, sesame seeds, soya bean, corn, etc. • Physical parameters: such as appearance, colour, odour, texture etc.
check safety norms of the defined work area and inform the safety in-charge if any non- compliance is observed.
interpret the process flow chart/formulation chart to identify the sequence of operations and process parameters.
transfer accepted raw materials to designated storage silos or bins as per standard operating procedures (SOP).
set up and assemble processing equipment and connections required for oil extraction, ensuring proper alignment of pipes, fittings, valves, and auxiliary components.
transfer raw materials from the storage silo to the cleaning machine as per the production schedule.
remove lighter impurities such as dust, straw, husk, and sticks using air aspiration or sieving equipment.
carry out the de-stoning process to remove heavier impurities and collect cleaned, de-stoned materials.
dispose of collected waste and impurities as per environmental and organisational SOPs.
transfer cleaned materials to the drying unit.
set controls of the dryer (temperature, air- flow, drying time) and perform the drying process to achieve the required moisture content (typically 6–8%).
set controls of the cooling fan (speed, air- flow) to perform cooling of the dried materials and bring them to ambient temperature.
transfer dried and cooled materials to intermediate holding bins for further processing.
set controls of the cracking mill (roller speed, clearance) to carry out the cracking of the cleaned and dried raw materials.
separate kernels and remove hulls by operating the de-hulling machine, if required for the type of seed.
adjust roller clearance in the flaking machine and feed cracked kernels through the hopper to obtain uniform flakes.
collect and inspect flakes for uniform thickness and structural integrity.
set parameters of the conditioning/cooking vessel (temperature, pressure, time) to prepare the flakes for oil extraction.
maintain process parameters by observing gauges and adjusting controls to ensure proper conditioning.
check the temperature and moisture content of the conditioned material and adjust by injecting water or steam as required.
feed measured quantity of conditioned raw materials into the screw press/extractor at a controlled rate.
set and monitor press parameters such as screw speed, barrel temperature, and pressure for efficient oil extraction.
take the sample of expelled oil cake/meal to assess the temperature and to determine that sufficient amount of oil has been removed
take a sample of the pressed oil cake or meal to assess residual oil content and temperature, and adjust press pressure or speed if required.
filter crude oil to remove suspended impurities before storage or refining.
take a representative sample of filtered oil and send it to the quality control laboratory for analysis.
transfer filtered crude oil to refining tanks or temporary storage as per SOP.
collect the by-product (oil cake/meal) for further processing, such as solvent extraction or for use as animal feed after drying and packing.

modules.module_title: Extract oil by solvent extraction method

pcs.pc_description: weigh flaked raw materials (oilseeds or oil cake/ meal) and transfer into the feeding hopper
adjust conveyor speed to maintain a uniform feeding rate of raw material into the extractor.
adjust dampers of the extractor conveyor to adjust the height of raw materials bed in the extractor
spray solvent and oil-solvent mixture (miscella) on the bed of raw materials flakes for oil extraction and on the materials conveyor screen to prevent clogging
collect the oil rich solvent (full miscella) in collection tank and oil extracted flakes

• transfer full miscella into distillation system and maintain process parameters for distillation system to remove solvent and separate oil • Distillation system: flash evaporator/ vacuum distillation unit/steam stripping unit • Controls of the distillation system: such as temperature, pressure, etc.
collect crude oil in container/storage tank after solvent recovery.
take sample of the crude oil and transfer it to quality lab for analysis
transfer spent meal to the desolventizer- toaster (DT) and set parameters such as temperature, steam pressure, and rotation speed to remove residual solvent and moisture.
cool, pack, and store desolventized meal as per SOP.
handle, store, and recover solvent safely in compliance with fire and environmental safety procedures.
record process parameters, yields, and solvent recovery details as per documentation and traceability SOPs.
select high-quality oilseeds (e.g., sesame, coconut, mustard, groundnut) and ensure they are cleaned and dried.
inspect oilseeds for impurities, moisture content, and foreign particles.
set up the cold press machine (screw press/hydraulic press/wooden ghani) as per SOP.
adjust machine parameters like pressure, speed, and temperature to ensure oil is extracted without exceeding 40-50°C.
feed the cleaned oilseeds into the cold press machine.
monitor the extraction process to ensure optimal yield without excessive heat generation.
collect raw oil in a stainless steel container to avoid contamination.
separate oilcake/residue and store it for by- product utilization (animal feed, organic manure).
use gravity filtration or fine cloth filter to remove sediments.
transfer filtered oil to a food-grade stainless steel or glass container.
store the oil in dark, cool conditions to prevent oxidation.
label and package oil as per regulatory and food safety standards.
conduct quality checks for parameters like colour, aroma, moisture, and free fatty acids.
maintain hygiene of the extraction area, cleaning machines and tools after each batch.

modules.module_title: Carry out degumming or neutralizing of oil

pcs.pc_description: arrange crude oil from the storage
prepare required chemicals as per work order
• set controls of the heat exchanger • Controls of heat exchanger: temperature, pressure, etc.
heat the oil to specified processing temperature
allow heated oil from heat exchanger to flow into centrifugal mixer by opening the valve

add measured quantities of acids (such as phosphoric or citric acid) and alkali solution (such as sodium hydroxide/caustic lye) in the defined sequence to carry out the neutralisation and acid- mixing process as per standard operating procedures (SOPs)
• set controls of the centrifuge to carry out separation of the non-hydratable gums and soap stock from oil • Controls: speed, time, etc.
• set controls of the heat exchanger and heat the oil after separation process • Controls: temperature, pressure, etc.
mix the hot water with oil for water washing process to remove residual gums
separate the neutralized oil and washed water
transfer neutralized oil to the collection tank
• set controls of the vacuum dryer and remove moisture from the neutralized oil under the vacuum • Controls: pressure, temperature, etc.
• set controls of the heat exchanger and heat and bleach the degummed and dried oil as per SOP • Controls: temperature, pressure, time, etc.
• set controls of the bleacher and spray heated oil through nozzles into bleacher evenly • Controls: pressure, temperature, retention time, etc.
remove any residual gums and soaps, colours, impurities, trace metals, etc., by bleaching earth
transfer dried oil and earth mixture into series of two pressure leaf filters to remove spent earth and collect filtered oil in filtrate receiver
polish the filtered oil and collect polished oil in bleached oil collection tank
remove residual oil and collect in recovered oil tank
perform quality check of spent earth residual oil to minimize losses
collect and dispose of spent bleaching earth safely as per environmental and organisational SOPs.
• heat the oil to a specified temperature to liquify the oil • Controls: temperature, pressure, flow rate, etc.
transfer heated oil to the storage tank
circulate cooling tower water to cool down the oil to certain temperature
circulate propylene glycol to gradually cool oil to required temperature as per SOP
• set controls of the agitator and agitate cooled oil at the specified speed for the specified time and temperature • Controls: temperature, speed, etc.
remove precipitated solids and collect filtered oil (clear oil with sparkling appearance) in the storage tank
take sample of dewaxed oil and transfer it to the quality analysis lab
transfer bleached oil to economizer to pre- heat oil to the specified temperature by using outgoing hot de-odourized oil
• set controls of the economizer • Controls of the economizer: temperature, time, etc.
create vacuum in the deaerator tank by pre- heating the oil to the specified temperature
• set controls of the de-odorizing economizer to remove free fatty acid and other volatile impurities from the oil along with steam • Controls: temperature, pressure, retention time, etc.
cool down the de-odourized oil in the de- odourizing economizer in bleaching plant
cool down the oil to storage temperature by spraying water from cooling water tower
collect oil in refined oil storage tank
• check the quality of finished product (de-odourized oil) through physical parameters • Physical parameters: colour, odour, viscosity, etc.
take sample and transfer it to the quality lab for the analysis
transfer refined oil into the filling tank of packaging machine
load packaging materials and labels in packaging machine
• set controls of the packaging, labeling, and date coding machines as per SOP • Controls: filling volume, date coding, batch number, date of manufacture, date of expiry, etc.
place the packed products in cartons and seal, and transfer them to the storage area and store as per SOP
add approved antioxidant to the refined oil, where applicable, before final filtration and packaging as per SOP
set controls in PLC for process parameters of each machinery, i.e., neutraliser, bleacher, crystalliser, de-odourizer

• perform final processing of refined oil and package the refined oil in case of fully automated process by passing the crude oil continuously through respective equipment • Final process: neutralize/degum, bleach, dewax, de- odorize • Equipment: neutralizer, bleacher, crystallizer, de- odourizer

document and maintain accurate records of production activities, process parameters, and finished product details, including raw materials used, production sequence, equipment performance, process flow chart, batch numbers, packing time, manufacturing and expiry dates, labelling information, and other data required for traceability and audits as per organisational procedures.
verify documents and track from finished product to ingredients, in case of quality concerns and for quality management system audits
report deviations or non-conformities to the supervisor and assist in implementing corrective actions

ensure periodic (daily/weekly/monthly/ quarterly/half yearly/annual) maintenance of all machines and equipment following the SOP or following suppliers’ instructions/manuals
